move: three phones spin a full 3D turn, phase-offset, with a bob
how: Three 230x470 phones built as front face, back face (camera bump and logo) and two side edges with backface-visibility hidden stand on a blurred floor glow. A fx.register seek loop drives everything from u = t/D: each phone's rotateY = u*360 + i*120 so they are a third of a turn apart, y bobs sin*14px, rotateX tilts sin*5 and rotateZ sits at -4 + 4i; the whole row sways rotateY sin*10 and the caption bobs 3px. All motion uses whole cycles of u so the 5s loop is seamless.
adapt: Replace the three theme pairs and screen names (or real screenshots), the back-face finish colours and the caption; change the 120deg phase offset for a different count. Keep one full turn per loop and the sine bob.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the floor, row and three phones from shot.screens; animate(el, shot, D) returns a timeline with one tween of duration D whose onUpdate runs the seek body (u = progress) applying gsap.set to each phone, the row and the caption, since the source is a fx.register seek loop. The row and caption selectors must be scoped to el; el needs perspective:2000px.
caveats: uses fx.register seek loop, not a GSAP timeline
the 1400x700 floor uses filter blur(10px) and rotateX 78deg
